title.zh: 在北伊罗戈省Bangui市镇设立医院，名称为北省医院，并授权为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act to Provide for the Establishment of a Hospital in the Municipality of Bangui, Province of Ilocos Norte, to be Known as Northern Provincial Hospital, and to Authorize the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act to Provide for the Establishment of a Hospital in the Municipality of Bangui, Province of Ilocos Norte, to be Known as Northern Provincial Hospital, and to Authorize the Appropriation of Funds Therefor

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1964/ra_4099_1964.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be established under the supervision of the Director of Medical Services, a hospital in the Municipality of Bangui, Province of Ilocos Norte, to be known as Northern Provincial Hospital.
The Secretary of Health shall issue such rules and regulation as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.

The sum of one hundred fifty thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the establishment, operation and maintenance of said hospital during the fiscal year nineteen hundred sixty-five. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Acts.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1964.
